title: Calibrating Forms for Minimal Graphs in Arbitrary Codimension
summary: We introduce a new family of closed differential forms naturally associated with minimal graphical submanifolds in Euclidean space, defined in arbitrary codimension. For each minimal graph, we construct an explicit closed form whose restriction coincides with the induced volume form. These forms admit a geometric interpretation as pullbacks, via the Gauss map, of tautological differential forms on the Grassmannian.
